skill.name: xlsx
skill.description: Create, edit, analyze, and validate spreadsheet files, including XLSX, CSV, and TSV. The skill explains pandas and openpyxl workflows, formula construction, financial formatting conventions, and optional LibreOffice-based formula recalculation.
skill.summary: Spreadsheet creation, editing, analysis, formatting, formula validation, and LibreOffice recalculation guidance.
skill.author: davila7

security_audit.summary: The main confirmed risks are the helper script running LibreOffice and writing a persistent macro into the user LibreOffice profile. Most SKILL.md detections are false positives caused by Markdown code fences, inline Excel error names, or documentation examples. No prompt injection attempt or data exfiltration intent was found in the reviewed files.

remediation.issue: Persistent macro is written into the user LibreOffice profile.
remediation.suggestion: Use an isolated temporary LibreOffice user profile for recalculation and remove it after the command completes.

remediation.issue: External commands are resolved through PATH.
remediation.suggestion: Resolve expected LibreOffice and timeout binaries explicitly, document the trust boundary, and reject unexpected executable paths.

remediation.issue: The helper scans every cell in every worksheet without size limits.
remediation.suggestion: Add workbook size limits, row and column caps, and clear timeout handling before opening untrusted or very large files.

remediation.issue: Documentation requires formula recalculation without warning about local profile changes.
remediation.suggestion: Add user-facing warnings that recalculation runs LibreOffice locally and may write temporary configuration files.

semantic_findings.title: Persistent LibreOffice Macro Installation
semantic_findings.description: The helper installs a StarBasic macro into the user LibreOffice profile and leaves it available after the skill finishes.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The setup function writes Module1.xba under the LibreOffice user profile and returns early if the macro already exists. This confirms persistent application-level modification.

semantic_findings.title: Unbounded Workbook Cell Scanning
semantic_findings.description: The recalculation helper scans every cell in every worksheet for errors and formulas, which can cause resource exhaustion on very large files.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: Comments and loops explicitly state that all rows and columns are checked without limits. Legitimate use is possible, but a crafted workbook could consume excessive CPU or memory.

content.value_statement: Spreadsheet work often breaks formulas, formatting, or data types. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through reliable XLSX creation, editing, analysis, and formula checks.
actual_capabilities: Read Excel, CSV, and TSV files with pandas for tabular analysis.
Create workbooks with formulas, styles, number formats, sheets, and column widths.
Edit existing workbooks while preserving formulas and formatting with openpyxl.
Recalculate formula results through LibreOffice using the included recalc.py helper.
Report common Excel formula errors with sheet and cell locations.
Document source assumptions and financial model formatting conventions.
limitations: Formula recalculation requires LibreOffice and can modify the local LibreOffice user profile.
It does not replace Microsoft Excel for features unsupported by openpyxl or LibreOffice.
Very large workbooks may be slow because the helper scans all cells.
It depends on Python spreadsheet libraries that must be available in the environment.

use_cases.title: Build a Dynamic Financial Model
use_cases.description: Create sheets with assumptions, formulas, formatting, source notes, and checks for common formula errors.

use_cases.title: Clean Spreadsheet Exports
use_cases.description: Read CSV or XLSX exports, summarize key fields, and produce a formatted workbook for review.

use_cases.title: Update Generated Reports
use_cases.description: Modify existing workbook templates while preserving formulas, styles, sheet structure, and calculated outputs.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Workbook
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an XLSX budget workbook with monthly rows, category columns, totals, currency formats, and a summary sheet.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze Workbook Data
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this workbook, summarize the main trends, identify missing values, and create a cleaned Excel output.

prompt_templates.title: Update a Template
prompt_templates.prompt: Update this Excel template with new data while preserving existing formulas, formatting, sheet names, and source notes.

prompt_templates.title: Validate Formula Outputs
prompt_templates.prompt: Recalculate this workbook, find formula errors, explain each issue by sheet and cell, and propose corrected formulas.

output_examples.input: Create a monthly sales workbook with revenue, costs, margin, and growth calculations.
output: Workbook with one data sheet and one summary sheet.
Formulas calculate totals, growth rates, and gross margin.
Headers, currency formats, and assumptions are formatted consistently.

output_examples.input: Review this workbook for broken formulas after adding a new product line.
output_examples.output: A concise report listing affected sheets, cell locations, error types, and recommended fixes.

output_examples.input: Convert a CSV export into an Excel dashboard for weekly operations review.
output_examples.output: A formatted workbook with cleaned data, summary metrics, charts, and documented source assumptions.

best_practices: Use Excel formulas for calculations so outputs update when source data changes.
Verify workbook references, sheet names, and edge cases before delivering the file.
Document hardcoded inputs with source notes, dates, and units.
anti_patterns: Hardcoding calculated totals that should remain formulas.
Saving a workbook loaded with data_only=True when formulas must be preserved.
Running recalculation on untrusted or very large files without review.

faq.question: Does this skill create Excel files?
faq.answer: Yes. It guides workbook creation with sheets, formulas, formatting, number formats, and source documentation.

faq.question: Can it edit existing workbooks?
faq.answer: Yes. It recommends openpyxl workflows that preserve workbook structure, formulas, and formatting where supported.

faq.question: How are formulas recalculated?
faq.answer: The included helper can run LibreOffice locally to recalculate formulas and check common Excel error values.

faq.question: Does it work with CSV files?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes pandas workflows for reading CSV, TSV, and Excel files before exporting formatted workbooks.

faq.question: Can it preserve formulas?
faq.answer: Yes, when workbooks are loaded and saved correctly. It warns against saving formula files after data-only loading.

faq.question: What should users review before installing it?
faq.answer: Review that the helper runs local commands and writes a LibreOffice macro for formula recalculation.
